text:
hana: Working on a quickstart refresh that walks users through a tiny containerized hello-world app + first deploy to our hosted API. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387. Putting notes here for coordination.

ricardo: Nice. Two asks: 1) show both Node + Python minimal examples, 2) call out auth best-practice (env var or secrets manager).

alexa: For the Dockerfile, can we include a HEALTHCHECK so platform users see best practice? Example I suggested in the PR: `HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1`

hana: Good call. Current Dockerfile snippet in the PR (Python):
```Dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=REPLACE_ME
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

ricardo: Suggest we don't hardcode the key in the file. Instead show `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY="" # set locally or via secrets` and an example `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 8080:8080 quickstart-hello`. Short note: "Do not commit your API key."

ci-bot: docs/checks  PR #4387  failing: mkdocs-material not found. See logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4387/logs

alexa: Oh, mkdocs dependency. Add `mkdocs-material>=9.0.0` to docs/requirements.txt and ensure mkdocs.yml uses the theme reference. I'll add a small PR to fix if you want.

hana: Please do. Also updating the Node snippet to pinned SDK: `@redwood/sdk@^5.2.0` and include an example using environment var:```js
// Node (express) quickstart snippet
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

ricardo: Can we include a tiny workflow step for smoke testing the examples? Something like a short GitHub Actions job that builds the Dockerfile and runs `curl /health`? I'll draft a snippet in the PR.

hana: Yes please. My goal: keep the quickstart single-page, link to full examples in `/examples/quickstart-node` and `/examples/quickstart-python`. Add a tiny note about SDK compatibility and a migration tip: "If you're upgrading from SDK v4, replace `new RedwoodClient({ key })` with `new Redwood({ apiKey: key })`."

tyler: Quick wording nit: change "first deploy" to "first run" in the opening paragraph to avoid implying infra provisioning. Also add a callout about rate limits for free tier users.

hana: Good call, updated PR. I'll rebase, add mkdocs fix, healthcheck, and the smoke workflow snippet tonight. If CI goes green I'll merge in the morning. Ping me in #docs for a quick review after the green build. :rocket:
